read_model: read a COLMAP reconstruction model from a folder in text or binary format and return cameras, images, and points3D
write_model: write cameras, images, and points3D data to a COLMAP model folder in text or binary format
qvec2rotmat: convert a COLMAP quaternion vector to a 3x3 rotation matrix
rotmat2qvec: convert a 3x3 rotation matrix to a COLMAP quaternion vector
read_array: read a .bin depth map file and return it as a numpy array
